g23-fixture-corpus.v4 established the linux-arm64 / linux-x86_64 / macos-arm64 / macos-x86_64 layout. g19-fixture-corpus.v3 adopts that layout for the 12x4=48 copies. Occupancy v2 passProperty over four platforms is preserved, not waived.
A later corpus successor may extend the platform axis if D-002 admits a further platform; g19-fixture-corpus.v3 enumerates the four occupancy v2 tokens only.
Whether each retained-evidence member requires its own separately digest-pinned record beyond the twelve INPUT cells is not decided here.
The byte schema of a digest-pinned declaration record, beyond quoting occupancy exactByteIntent, is not decided here.
A later dedicated SATISFIED-GRADE cycle may test DR-G19 only when D-056 five gates hold. Gate 1 Class A remains unopened. g19-fixture-corpus.v3 is not that cycle.
remeasurementClause: If a cited file moves in a way that is not append-only COORD growth or COORD heading hygiene, with file 08, g19 leftover-join.v6, g19 leftover-join.v5, state-class leftover-join.v4, occupancy v2, the twelve fixtures/g19.v1/ fixture files, the forty-eight fixtures/g19.v2/ copies, frozen g19-fixture-corpus.v1, frozen g19-fixture-corpus.v2, and g19-fixture-corpus.v3 unmoved, remasure before recording. recordedInputs.HEAD must equal the top-level head. Frozen range for prior corpus versions is g19-fixture-corpus.v1 through g19-fixture-corpus.v2.
